evaluated_cases.case_label: 1. Depressive Presentation with Hidden Hypomanic History (Bipolar II Differential)

validity_notes: Response consistency (VRIN) and validity indicators within interpretable clinical bounds.

auxiliary_prosody_signal.authority_weight: AUXILIARY_CONTEXT_ONLY (0% standalone diagnostic authority per biological-data-governance.md §8)

medical_mimics_to_rule_out: Endocrine / Metabolic panel: TSH & Free T4 (hypothyroidism mimics major depression & fatigue)
Hematology / Micronutrients: Serum Ferritin, Vitamin B12, Folate, and 25-OH Vitamin D
Cardiopulmonary / Stimulant screen: Hyperthyroidism, caffeine/stimulant intake, or arrhythmia/POTS
Polysomnography / Sleep Medicine rule-out: Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA) or circadian phase disorder driving daytime mood/cognitive fatigue
differential_overlaps_flagged: CRITICAL DIFFERENTIAL: Co-elevated PHQ-9 (>=10) and MDQ (>=7). Must rule out Bipolar II / Mixed Features before initiating unopposed antidepressant monotherapy.
shadow_critique.biometric_uncertainty_notice: Per OI Biological Data Governance (§4, §8): Acoustic prosody and self-report scales are uncertain measurements, not ground-truth identity or autonomous diagnoses.

primary_working_hypotheses: Bipolar Spectrum / Cyclothymic or Depressive Episode with Mixed/Hypomanic History (Provisional Screen).
Clinically Significant Sleep-Wake Disruption (Moderate Insomnia / Fragmentation (11–15)).
recommended_next_steps: Structured clinical interview (SCID-5) for lifetime manic/hypomanic episodes prior to pharmacotherapy decisions.
Clinician review of autonomic stressors, stimulant/sleep factors, and anxiety-focused care.
Evaluate sleep hygiene, circadian schedule, and sleep-disordered breathing (CBT-I / sleep study if indicated).
